name: tiptap-markdown-react
description: Batteries-included Markdown WYSIWYG editor + reader built on Tiptap v3 (markdown in/out, SSR, TOC, themeable, antd-free).

paragraphs: A batteries-included, self-styled Markdown WYSIWYG editor + reader suite built on Tiptap v3. Markdown in, markdown out — plus a table of contents, a client preview, and a server-side (RSC/SSR) renderer for SEO-friendly reading pages. No Ant Design, no icon library; themeable via CSS variables.
Live demo → — the docs site with runnable editor demos (source in site/). Auto-deployed from main.
features: Markdown-first: content goes in and comes out as markdown (getMarkdown()), with getHTML() / getJSON() also exposed.
Equations: toolbar inserts inline / block math (KaTeX). Markdown round-trip uses $$…$$ (inline) and newline-wrapped $$ (block). Typing $ / $$ stays as text so dollar amounts are safe.
Charts: agentic-ui-compatible data charts ( + GFM table). Chart.js renders in editor / preview / reader (SSR placeholder → client hydrate). MVP: line, bar, column, pie, donut, area.
Own opinionated UI: toolbar, color palette, code block, and table of contents ship styled out of the box. Zero antd. Dropdowns/popovers use Radix primitives; icons are inline SVG.

Editor + Preview + Static reader: edit, live client-side preview, and a pure renderReportHtml() for server rendering (Next.js Server Components / ISR). Reading pages that only hydrate footnotes should import…
